name: Asia Insurance
tagline: OSGO auto liability and travel insurance bought in-app, plus roadside help on a map
role: iOS and Android app development for an Uzbek insurer

scenes.title: Insurance without an office visit
scenes.body: Compulsory OSGO auto liability and travel insurance on the home screen, next to company news.

scenes.title: An OSGO quote, one step at a time
scenes.body: Vehicle type, region, claims history, violations, benefits and drivers set the premium.

scenes.title: Travel cover shaped by the trip
scenes.body: Destinations, cover package, trip type, purpose and group size drive the quote; Payme handles payment.

scenes.title: Policies, claims and roadside help
scenes.body: Order history, policy lookup by number, and GPS-tagged help requests that other users can answer.
